channel.title: Guidelark
channel.description: Practical budgeting, saving, side-income and debt guides for students and people on small incomes. No jargon and no get-rich-quick promises.

item.title: How to Travel on a Budget: Plan a Holiday for Less
item.description: How to travel on a budget: choose when and where to go, cut transport and stays, set a daily spending limit, and plan a 4-day trip for $650.

item.title: What Is a High-Yield Savings Account (And Is It Worth It?)
item.description: What a high-yield savings account is, how much more it can earn than a regular account, whether it is safe, and how to open one in about 15 minutes.

item.title: Why Your Budget Keeps Failing (And How to Fix It)
item.description: Why your budget keeps failing: guessed numbers, no fun money, forgotten yearly bills and no buffer. Six fixes, with a worked example that adds up.

item.title: Sinking Funds for Beginners: Save a Little Each Month
item.description: Learn how sinking funds for beginners work. Turn big irregular bills into small monthly savings with a simple starter plan.

item.title: How to Split Bills With Roommates Fairly (With Template)
item.description: Learn how to split bills with roommates fairly: equal, room-size, and income methods, a worked example, and a copy-paste template.

item.title: How to Stop Impulse Spending (Without Giving Up Fun)
item.description: Learn how to stop impulse spending with rules that work: a 24-hour pause, a fun-money cap, and friction at checkout. No guilt trips.

item.title: How to Build Credit From Scratch in the US (2026 Guide)
item.description: Learn how to build credit from scratch in the US: secured cards, authorized users, credit-builder loans, and a 12-month plan. No hype, just steps.

item.title: How to Budget With Irregular Income: A Simple System
item.description: Learn how to budget with irregular income: pay yourself a steady salary, build a buffer, and handle taxes without the monthly guesswork.

item.title: Biweekly Budget Template: Plan Your Money Paycheck by Paycheck
item.description: Paid every two weeks? This free biweekly budget template shows which bills each paycheck must cover, spots short paychecks and three-payday months.

item.title: Emergency Fund Calculator: How Much You Need and How Long It Takes
item.description: A free emergency fund calculator for Google Sheets and Excel. See your target from a $500 starter fund to six months of essentials, and when you'll get there.

item.title: Free Bill Tracker Template: Never Miss a Due Date
item.description: A free bill tracker for Google Sheets and Excel that shows days left until each bill is due, highlights bills due soon and has a monthly checklist.

item.title: Free Debt Snowball Spreadsheet (With an Avalanche Option)
item.description: A free debt payoff spreadsheet for Google Sheets and Excel. Switch between snowball and avalanche to see your payoff order, debt-free date and interest.

item.title: Free Monthly Budget Template for Google Sheets and Excel
item.description: A free monthly budget template for Google Sheets and Excel, built for small incomes, with step-by-step setup, a worked example and how the formulas work.

item.title: Free Savings Goal Tracker Spreadsheet (With Progress Bars)
item.description: A free savings goal tracker for Google Sheets and Excel that works out how much to save each month for every goal, with progress bars.

item.title: Google Sheets vs Excel for Budgeting: Which Should You Use?
item.description: Google Sheets or Excel for your budget? A plain comparison of cost, phone use, offline access, privacy and formulas, and how to choose in one minute.

item.title: How to Track Expenses in Google Sheets (Free Template)
item.description: Track your spending in Google Sheets with a free expense tracker: log purchases, pick a month and see totals by category, step by step.

item.title: Monthly Money Review: A 20-Minute Checklist That Works
item.description: A monthly money review you can finish in 20 minutes: a five-step checklist, a worked example with real numbers, and what to do when a month goes badly.

item.title: Sinking Funds Spreadsheet: Save for Costs That Aren't Monthly
item.description: A free sinking funds spreadsheet for Google Sheets and Excel that works out how much to set aside each month for every known cost, with a worked example.

item.title: SUMIF and SUMIFS in Google Sheets: A Budgeting Guide
item.description: Learn SUMIF and SUMIFS in Google Sheets and Excel with seven budgeting examples, a free practice workbook and fixes for common mistakes.

item.title: Lifestyle Inflation Examples: 10 Ways Your Raise Disappears
item.description: 10 lifestyle inflation examples with rough monthly costs, two worked budgets, a simple raise-capture test, and six ways to stop lifestyle creep.
